title: Warehouse Inventory Aging
description: Aged inventory by SKU and location: lot/DOT manufacturing data, received and product age, on-hand, allocated and available quantity, and inventory value.

sources.label: Modern schema (WMS.*)
sources.note: Relational lab schema: surrogate keys, DATE columns, descriptive status values.

sources.label: Legacy IBM i-style (LGCYLIB)
sources.note: Same data in legacy IBM i conventions: 10-character file names, blank-padded CHAR, numeric YYYYMMDD / CYYMMDD dates, one-letter status codes, natural keys. The SQL converts it back, so the same RTF template renders it unchanged, and a reconciliation query proves both sources match.
